tasks.title: The Economics of Academic Tenure
paras: In some countries, many universities use an employment system for teachers known as tenure. A tenured faculty member enjoys considerable job security for the rest of his or her working life and can only be fired for reasons of "moral turpitude" (bad or evil behavior) or "gross incompetence" or if the financial stability of the institution requires the elimination of an entire department or program.

The high degree of job security enjoyed by tenured faculty members has been the source of complaints about the tenure system. One issue that has been raised by many, including legislators evaluating the finances and managerial practices of state universities in the United States, is that tenure shelters faculty from accountability for poor performance. Another argument is that tenure makes the university inefficient in responding to changing instructional demands. It is difficult to substitute computer engineering faculty for civil engineering faculty if most of the latter have tenure. In 1988, the Education Reform Act significantly “softened” the tenure system in the United Kingdom, making it easier to fire individual faculty members for financial reasons. More recently, some universities in the United States have taken steps to give university administrators more control over tenured professors. And, in general, American institutions of higher learning have tended to increase the use of part-time and nontenured instructors over time.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?

options.A: The benefits of tenure for university faculty members
options.B: The history of academic tenure in the United States and United Kingdom
options.C: The criticisms and reforms of the academic tenure system
options.D: The differences between tenured and nontenured faculty roles

questions.analysis: 题型：主旨题 原文分析：文章第一段介绍了什么叫做tenure，以及tenure非常的secure。但是整个第二段列举了一些complaints（One issue… Another argument …），然后讲到了一些reforms的措施（the Education Reform Act … More recently, some universities … And, in general, American institutions …）。 选项分析： A选项，The benefits of tenure只能概括第一段的部分信息，不是整个文章的重点。 B选项，文章没有讲tenure的发展史。 D选项，文章没有重点讲tenured and nontenured faculty roles的差别。

questions.stem: The word “shelters” in the passage is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 题型：词汇题 选项分析：shelter做动词，是“遮蔽、保护”的意思。等于protect。 B选项是“支持”的意思。C选项是“隐藏”的意思。D选项是“促进”的意思。

questions.stem: According to the passage some critics of the tenure system believe that tenure can

options.A: reduce faculty members' motivation to do their jobs well
options.B: cause faculty members to prefer employment in state universities over employment in other universities
options.C: remove moral turpitude as a criterion for evaluating a faculty member's performance
options.D: encourage faculty members to switch from one department or program to another within a university

questions.analysis: 题型：细节题 原文分析：根据题目进行定位。定位在第二段的各种complaints（One issue… Another argument …）。翻译是：许多人，包括评估美国州立大学财务和管理实践的立法者，提出了一个问题，即终身教职使教师免受因表现不佳而承担责任的约束。另一个论点是，终身教职使大学在应对不断变化的教学需求时效率低下。如果大多数土木工程教师拥有终身教职，很难用计算机工程教师来替代他们。“终身教职使教师免受因表现不佳而承担责任的约束”对应A选项“降低把工作做好的动机”。 选项分析： B 没提及。文章没有state universities和other universities的对比。 C 没提及。翻译是：删除道德败坏作为评估教职员工绩效的标准。 D 没提及。文章没有从one department or program转换到another (program)的说法。

questions.stem: Why does the author mention “It is difficult to substitute computer engineering faculty for civil engineering faculty if most of the latter have tenure”?

options.A: To illustrate the financial burdens of maintaining tenured faculty
options.B: To highlight the inefficiency of the tenure system in adapting to changing instructional demands
options.C: To compare the qualifications of computer engineering and civil engineering faculty
options.D: To emphasize the job security benefits of tenure for faculty members

questions.analysis: 题型：修辞目的题 原文分析：题目定位的句子是解释上一句的“Another argument is that tenure makes the university inefficient in responding to changing instructional demands.”。翻译是：另一个论点是，终身教职使大学在应对不断变化的教学需求时效率低下。对应B选项。 其他选项跟定位点上一句的信息不想关，排除。

questions.stem: According to paragraph 2, all of the following steps have been taken in response to complaints about tenure EXCEPT

options.A: passing a law that allows universities to fire professors in order to save money
options.B: providing administrators with more control of professors who have tenure
options.C: allowing each department to have the same percentage of tenured faculty

questions.analysis: 题型：否定事实信息题 原文分析：根据题目定位到第二段的reforms的措施（the Education Reform Act … More recently, some universities … And, in general, American institutions …）。翻译是：1988年，英国的《教育改革法案》显著“软化”了终身教职制度，使得以财务原因为由解雇个别教职员工变得更容易。近期，美国的一些大学采取措施，赋予大学管理者对终身教授更多的控制权。总体而言，美国高等教育机构随着时间推移，倾向于增加使用兼职和非终身教职的教师。 选项分析： C选项，没提及。文章没说过same percentage of tenured faculty。 其中“英国的《教育改革法案》显著“软化”了终身教职制度，使得以财务原因为由解雇个别教职员工变得更容易”对应A选项。 其中“赋予大学管理者对终身教授更多的控制权”对应B选项。 其中“倾向于增加使用兼职和非终身教职的教师”对应D选项。
